root_cause.text: In bh1780_read_raw(), the PM runtime reference acquired via pm_runtime_get_sync() is not released on the error path when bh1780_read_word() returns a negative value, because pm_runtime_put_autosuspend() is placed after the error return.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `pm_runtime_put_autosuspend()` before the `if (value < 0) return value;` check, ensuring the reference is decremented regardless of success or failure of the read operation.
